name: fillet_face_between_the_top_and_the_hole_of_the_plan
why: THE FACE FILLET BETWEEN TWO FACES THAT THE PLAN MAKES (0.131.0). fillet_face took only identifiers, and with two faces a single face_ref cannot name both (ResolveFace would return the same face twice). Each face now has its own reference, face_1_ref and face_2_ref: here the top of the plate of step 1 and the cylindrical wall of the hole of step 2, which round the mouth of the hole. A plan of three steps, no reading of the state in between.
_the_number: The section removed at the mouth of a hole of radius R by a fillet of radius r is r^2 (1 - pi/4), and its centroid is at 10.670104 mm from the axis (R = 10, r = 3: the square minus the quarter disc, Pappus). The volume is 2 pi * 10.670104 * 1.931417 = 129.4865 mm3. On a STRAIGHT edge of the same length (2 pi R) it would be 121.3545: the difference, 8.1 mm3, is the reason why the number is not the straight-edge formula, which the operation only compares for flat faces (expected_change_abs_mm3 is null here, and the answer says so).
